review_notes: I read the whole file. It has one cylinder bound, shell cover and disjointness lemmas, a scaling identity, a tail-sum bound and the final tail estimate. It also has two definitions. positiveShell is a ℕ-indexed family of sets, and parabolicTailKernelConstant is an ENNReal constant (a tsum). Neither is a map with homomorphism, continuity, equivalence or action structure. The theorems are inequalities and set-cover facts, so there is nothing to bundle. I grepped for uses of positiveShell and the tail constant elsewhere in the repo and found only inequality-style consumers, so none shows a bundling gap. The remaining uncertainty is that I did not read the consumers in Adams*.lean closely.
